435: Data API / Backlinks
436: Backlinks
437: Backlinks API retrieves backlink data for a target domain, host, or URL. It provides aggregated metrics such as counts of backlinks, referring domains, IPs, and subnets, as well as anchor texts, top pages, TLDs, and countries. The API includes endpoints for summary metrics, historical data, raw backlink lists, export options, and authority scores. Data is refreshed on a monthly basis.
438: Using the API, you can:
439: retrieve backlink summary metrics, including counts of backlinks, referring domains, IPs, subnets, top anchors, TLDs, and countries
440: retrieve key backlink metrics in batch for multiple targets
441: list all backlinks for a single target
442: fetch backlinks in batches for large datasets
443: track new, lost, cumulative, and daily backlink changes
444: retrieve backlink anchor texts
445: access referring domains, including counts and new/lost domains
446: access referring IPs and subnets, including counts
447: list indexed pages with backlinks
448: retrieve page and domain authority metrics, including distributions, histograms, and historical values
449: export backlink data for large-scale analysis
450: Get backlink summary
451: GET / POST https://api.seranking.com/v1/backlinks/summary
452: Cost: 100 credits per target
453: Returns extended statistics for a target, including the number of backlinks, referring domains, subnets, IPs, top anchors, top TLDs, and more. This endpoint supports GET and POST requests and allows batching of up to 100 targets per request. Pass multiple targets as GET parameters separated by & or in the POST body (JSON format).
454: Request parameters
455: Note:
456: The apikey (required) and output (optional) parameters must always be included as GET parameters, even if other parameters are sent via POST.
457: Any POST data in the request body should be in JSON format.
458: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
459: apikeyStringYesN/AAPI key for authentication. Must always be sent as a GET parameter.
460: targetStringYesN/ATarget to analyze: root domain, host (subdomain), or specific URL (e.g., seranking.com).
461: modeStringNohostMode of operation:
462: • domain – analyzes all URLs in the domain, including subdomains.
463: • host – analyzes all URLs under this host only (subdomains excluded).
464: • url – analyzes a single, specific URL.
465: outputStringNojsonResponse format (json or xml). Must always be sent as a GET parameter.
466: Request examples
467: GET (single target)
468: Copy
469: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/backlinks/summary?target=rubyonrails.org&mode=host&output=json' \
470: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
471: GET (multiple targets)
472: Copy
473: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/backlinks/summary?target=https://www.seranking.com&target=https://www.seranking.com&mode=url&output=json' \
474: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
475: POST (multiple targets)
476: Copy
477: curl -X POST \
478: 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/backlinks/summary?output=json' \
479: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY' \
480: -d '{
481: "target": [
482: "https://www.seranking.com/",
483: "https://www.seranking.com/"
484: ],
485: "mode": "host"
486: }'
487: Response parameters
488: ParameterTypeDescription
489: targetStringTarget analyzed: root domain, host (subdomain), or specific URL (e.g., seranking.com).
490: backlinksIntegerNumber of live backlinks linking to the target.
491: refdomainsIntegerNumber of unique domains linking to the target.
492: subnetsIntegerNumber of unique subnets (C-blocks) linking to the target.
493: ipsIntegerNumber of unique IP addresses linking to the target.
494: nofollow_backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks classified as nofollow.
495: dofollow_backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks classified as dofollow.
496: from_home_page_backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks originating from the home page of the referring domain.
497: dofollow_from_home_page_backlinksIntegerNumber of dofollow backlinks originating from the home page of the referring domain.
498: text_backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks with text anchors.
499: edu_backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks originating from .edu domains.
500: gov_backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks originating from .gov domains.
501: inlink_rankIntegerPage Authority of the target URL.
502: domain_inlink_rankIntegerDomain Authority of the target’s root domain.
503: dofollow_refdomainsIntegerNumber of referring domains with at least one dofollow backlink.
504: from_home_page_refdomainsIntegerNumber of referring domains linking from the home page.
505: edu_refdomainsIntegerNumber of .edu referring domains.
506: gov_refdomainsIntegerNumber of .gov referring domains.
507: anchorsIntegerNumber of unique anchor texts used across all backlinks.
508: dofollow_anchorsIntegerNumber of unique anchor texts used in dofollow backlinks.
509: pages_with_backlinksIntegerNumber of target pages that have at least one backlink.
510: top_anchors_by_backlinksArrayTop anchor texts sorted by number of backlinks (descending).
511: top_anchors_by_backlinks.anchorStringAnchor text used in backlinks (by total backlinks).
512: top_anchors_by_backlinks.backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks using this anchor text.
513: top_anchors_by_refdomainsArrayTop anchor texts sorted by number of referring domains (descending).
514: top_anchors_by_refdomains.anchorStringAnchor text used in backlinks (by referring domains).
515: top_anchors_by_refdomains.refdomainsIntegerNumber of referring domains with at least one backlink using this anchor text.
516: top_pages_by_backlinksArrayTarget pages sorted by number of backlinks (descending).
517: top_pages_by_backlinks.urlStringURL of the target page.
518: top_pages_by_backlinks.backlinksIntegerNumber of backlinks pointing to this page.
519: top_pages_by_refdomainsArrayTarget pages sorted by number of referring domains (descending).
520: top_pages_by_refdomains.urlStringURL of the target page.
521: top_pages_by_refdomains.refdomainsIntegerNumber of referring domains pointing to this page.
522: top_tldsArrayTop-level domains (TLDs) sorted by number of backlinks (descending).
523: top_tlds.tldStringTop-level domain (e.g., .com).
524: top_tlds.countIntegerNumber of backlinks originating from this TLD.
525: top_countriesArrayTop countries sorted by number of backlinks (descending).
526: top_countries.countryStringCountry code.
527: top_countries.countIntegerNumber of backlinks originating from this country.

778: Fetch backlinks in batches
779: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/backlinks/raw
780: Cost: 1 credit per backlink
781: Returns all backlinks pointing to a target using cursor-based pagination. Backlinks are delivered in sequential batches. This method supports pagination and doesn’t provide sorting or filtering. Unlike the List all backlinks method, which supports ordering (e.g., by InLink Rank or recency), this endpoint is designed for complete backlink retrieval, batch by batch.
782: Pagination is handled via a cursor (next parameter). The cursor marks a specific position in the dataset and remains valid unless the item is removed. Cursors are typically valid for up to 24 hours, even if new backlinks are added.
783: The next parameter must not be included when requesting the first page of data. Doing so will return an error.

1696: Cost: 1 credit per site page

1698: A page is included if it has at least one live backlink.
1699: Pages that no longer have backlinks are excluded.
1700: The returned list contains no duplicate pages, with protocol differences taken into account when determining page uniqueness. This endpoint supports GET and POST requests, but doesn’t support batching. Only a single target can be specified per request.
1701: Request parameters
1702: Note:

435: Data API / Domain Analysis
436: Domain Analysis
437: Domain Analysis API provides detailed insights into a domain’s search performance. Data is refreshed on a monthly basis.
438: Using the API, you can:
439: query regional or worldwide data
440: retrieve keyword statistics, domain pages, and subdomains
441: analyze competitors to identify common keywords and keyword gaps
442: retrieve paid advertising data, including ad creatives, observed positions, and traffic
443: access historical data to track changes in rankings, traffic, and ad performance
444: filter and sort results by metrics such as search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty, and ranking positions
445: Get domain overview by region
446: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/overview/db
447: Cost: 100 credits per request
448: Returns detailed keyword statistics for a specified domain within a single, selected regional database. It breaks down performance for both organic and paid traffic, offering insights into keyword rankings, traffic estimates, and position changes.
449: Request parameters
450: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
451: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code of the regional keyword database (e.g., us). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
452: domainStringYesN/ADomain for which to retrieve the keyword statistics (e.g., seranking.com).
453: with_subdomainsIntegerNo1Flag indicating whether subdomain data should be included in the analysis:
454: 1 – include subdomains
455: 0 – exclude subdomains
456: urlStringNoN/ASpecific URL to analyze instead of the root domain
457: (e.g., https://domain.com/path/page). If provided, the domain parameter is ignored.
458: Request example
459: Copy
460: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/overview/db?source=xx&domain=yourdomain.com&with_subdomains=1' \
461: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
462: Response parameters
463: If the request is successful, the server returns a JSON object with two primary keys: organic and adv. Each of these keys details various keyword statistics for the selected database.
464: organic object
465: ParameterTypeDescription
466: organic.base_domain / organic.targetStringBase domain or URL used for the analysis.
467: organic.keywords_countIntegerNumber of organic keywords for which the domain ranks in the selected database.
468: organic.traffic_sumIntegerEstimated monthly organic search traffic from ranking keywords.
469: organic.price_sumFloatEstimated traffic value (PPC equivalent) for organic search data.
470: organic.keywords_new_countIntegerNumber of keywords for which the domain has newly started ranking.
471: organic.keywords_up_countIntegerNumber of keywords for which the domain’s ranking has improved.
472: organic.keywords_down_countIntegerNumber of keywords for which the domain’s ranking has declined.
473: organic.keywords_equal_countIntegerNumber of keywords for which the domain’s ranking has not changed.
474: organic.keywords_lost_countIntegerNumber of keywords for which the domain has dropped out of the SERPs.
475: organic.top1_5IntegerNumber of organic keywords ranked in positions 1–5.
476: organic.top6_10IntegerNumber of organic keywords ranked in positions 6–10.
477: organic.top11_20IntegerNumber of organic keywords ranked in positions 11–20.
478: organic.top21_50IntegerNumber of organic keywords ranked in positions 21–50.
479: organic.top51_100IntegerNumber of organic keywords ranked in positions 51–100.
480: organic.yearIntegerYear of the data snapshot.
481: organic.monthIntegerMonth of the data snapshot.
482: adv object
483: ParameterTypeDescription
484: adv.base_domain / adv.targetStringBase domain or URL used for the analysis.
485: adv.keywords_countIntegerNumber of keywords for which the domain has paid ads in the selected database.
486: adv.traffic_sumIntegerEstimated monthly traffic from paid keywords.
487: adv.price_sumFloatEstimated traffic value (PPC equivalent) from paid keywords.
488: adv.keywords_new_countIntegerNumber of new keywords targeted by paid ads.
489: adv.keywords_up_countIntegerNumber of paid keywords where ad positions improved.
490: adv.keywords_down_countIntegerNumber of paid keywords where ad positions declined.
491: adv.keywords_equal_countIntegerNumber of paid keywords where ad positions remained unchanged.
492: adv.keywords_lost_countIntegerNumber of keywords for which paid ads are no longer running or appearing in the SERPs.
493: adv.top1_2IntegerNumber of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 1–2.
494: adv.top3_5IntegerNumber of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 3–5.
495: adv.top6_8IntegerNumber of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 6–8.
496: adv.top9_11IntegerNumber of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 9–11.
497: adv.yearIntegerYear of the data snapshot.
498: adv.monthIntegerMonth of the data snapshot.

538: Get worldwide domain overview
539: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/overview/worldwide
540: Cost: 100 credits per request
541: Aggregates and returns domain search performance statistics globally for the current month. The method provides a comprehensive view of worldwide organic and paid traffic metrics, with options to customize the returned data, including currency and specific fields.
542: Request parameters
543: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
544: domainStringYesN/ADomain name for which to retrieve worldwide statistics (e.g., seranking.com).
545: currencyStringNoUSDISO 4217 currency code to be used for any monetary values (like traffic cost) returned in the response (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
546: fieldsStringNoprice, traffic, keywordsComma-separated list specifying which data fields or categories to include in the response:
547: • price – shows traffic price/cost value
548: • traffic – shows traffic volume value
549: • keywords – shows keyword count statistics
550: • positions_diff – shows statistics on position changes
551: • positions_tops – shows statistics on top-ranking positions
552: show_zones_listStringNo0Identifies whether the response should include a detailed breakdown of statistics by regional zone (country) in addition to aggregated worldwide statistics:
553: 1 – include stats for each zone
554: 0 – return worldwide stats only
555: with_subdomainsIntegerNo1Flag indicating whether subdomain data should be included in the analysis:
556: 1 – include subdomains
557: 0 – exclude subdomains
558: urlStringNoN/ASpecific URL to analyze instead of the root domain
559: (e.g., https://domain.com/path/page). If provided, the domain parameter is ignored.
560: Request example
561: Copy
562: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/overview/worldwide?domain=seranking.com&currency=USD&fields=price,traffic,keywords,positions_diff,positions_tops&show_zones_list=0' \
563: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
564: Response parameters
565: If the request is successful, the server returns a JSON object with two primary keys: organic and adv. Each of these keys holds an array of objects.
566: The first object in each array always represents the aggregated “worldwide” statistics.
567: If show_zones_list is set to “1” (or true), subsequent objects in the arrays will represent statistics for individual regional zones (countries).
568: Each object within the organic and adv arrays can contain the following parameters (depending on the fields requested):
569: ParameterTypeDescription
570: sourceStringIdentifier of the data scope:
571: worldwide for the global summary, or a specific country code for zone-specific data when show_zones_list is enabled.
572: countryStringDescriptive name for the source: worldwide for the global summary, or country name for zone-specific data (e.g., United States).
573: keywords_countIntegerNumber of keywords for this scope (organic or paid, depending on the parent object).
574: traffic_sumIntegerSum of estimated traffic for this scope (organic or paid).
575: price_sumFloatEstimated traffic value (PPC equivalent) in the specified currency.
576: positions_new_countIntegerNumber of keywords newly appearing in rankings for this scope (if positions_diff requested in fields).
577: positions_up_countIntegerNumber of keywords with improved rankings for this scope (if positions_diff requested in fields).
578: positions_down_countIntegerNumber of keywords with declined rankings for this scope (if positions_diff requested in fields).
579: positions_lost_countIntegerNumber of keywords that dropped out of rankings for this scope (if positions_diff requested in fields).
580: positions_equal_countIntegerNumber of keywords with unchanged rankings for this scope (if positions_diff requested in fields).
581: positions_tops.top1_5IntegerOrganic: keywords in positions 1–5.
582: positions_tops.top6_10IntegerOrganic: keywords in positions 6–10.
583: positions_tops.top11_20IntegerOrganic: keywords in positions 11–20.
584: positions_tops.top21_50IntegerOrganic: keywords in positions 21–50.
585: positions_tops.top51_100IntegerOrganic: keywords in positions 51–100.
586: positions_tops.top1_2IntegerPaid (adv): keywords with ads in positions 1–2.
587: positions_tops.top3_5IntegerPaid (adv): keywords with ads in positions 3–5.
588: positions_tops.top6_8IntegerPaid (adv): keywords with ads in positions 6–8.
589: positions_tops.top9_11IntegerPaid (adv): keywords with ads in positions 9–11.

674: Get domain traffic and keyword history
675: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/overview/history
676: Cost: 100 credits per request
677: Retrieves historical data for a specified domain from a specific regional database. It tracks changes over time for key metrics, including the number of keywords, estimated traffic (clicks), and traffic cost estimates, for either organic or paid search.
678: Request parameters
679: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
680: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code of the regional keyword database (e.g., us). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
681: domainStringYesN/ADomain name for which to retrieve historical performance data (e.g., seranking.com).
682: typeStringNoorganicSearch traffic type for which data is retrieved:
683: • organic – organic search traffic
684: • adv – paid search traffic
685: with_subdomainsIntegerNo1Flag indicating whether subdomain data should be included in the analysis:
686: 1 – include subdomains
687: 0 – exclude subdomains
688: urlStringNoN/ASpecific URL to analyze instead of the root domain
689: (e.g., https://domain.com/path/page). If provided, the domain parameter is ignored.
690: Request examples
691: To retrieve organic historical data:
692: Copy
693: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/overview/history?source=us&domain=seranking.com&type=organic' \
694: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
695: To retrieve paid (advertising) historical data:
696: Copy
697: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/overview/history?source=us&domain=seranking.com&type=adv' \
698: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
699: Response parameters
700: If the request is successful, the server returns a JSON array. Each object in this array represents a historical data point (typically for a specific month and year) and contains the following parameters.
701: Note:
702: The topX_Y fields for ranking distribution correspond to the type of traffic requested—organic ranking ranges or paid ad position ranges.
703: The topX_Y fields count position occurrences, not unique keywords. If a domain has multiple links for a single keyword, each link is counted separately in the relevant position range(s). As a result, the sum of top1_5 + top6_10 + … + top51_100 may exceed keywords_count.
704: ParameterTypeDescription
705: keywords_countIntegerNumber of unique keywords (organic or paid, depending on the request type) for which the domain had at least one result during the period.
706: traffic_sumIntegerEstimation of the total search traffic (clicks) the domain received from these keywords during that period.
707: price_sumFloatEstimated traffic value (PPC equivalent) in the default currency of the database.
708: yearIntegerYear of the historical data point.
709: monthIntegerMonth of the historical data point (1–12).
710: top1_5IntegerIf type is organic: total number of occurrences of organic keywords ranked in positions 1–5 during that period.
711: top6_10IntegerIf type is organic: total number of occurrences of organic keywords ranked in positions 6–10 during that period.
712: top11_20IntegerIf type is organic: total number of occurrences of organic keywords ranked in positions 11–20 during that period.
713: top21_50IntegerIf type is organic: total number of occurrences of organic keywords ranked in positions 21–50 during that period.
714: top51_100IntegerIf type is organic: total number of occurrences of organic keywords ranked in positions 51–100 during that period.
715: top1_2IntegerIf type is adv: total number of occurrences of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 1–2 during that period.
716: top3_5IntegerIf type is adv: total number of occurrences of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 3–5 during that period.
717: top6_8IntegerIf type is adv: total number of occurrences of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 6–8 during that period.
718: top9_11IntegerIf type is adv: total number of occurrences of paid keywords with ads appearing in positions 9–11 during that period.
719: Response examples
720: Note: topX_Y fields reflect total result occurrences, not unique keywords. This is why their sum can exceed keywords_count.

775: Get domain keyword rankings
776: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/keywords
777: Cost: current snapshot (no year / month) — 100 credits per request; keyword history (past year + month) — 5 credits per returned keyword, no per-request charge. See Historical snapshots (year / month) below.
778: Returns the keywords a domain (or a specific URL) ranks for in a regional database, organic or paid. Supports historical month-by-month snapshots, advanced filtering across keyword properties, SERP-feature presence, search intent, and traffic share.
779: Request parameters
780: Required fields
781: Either domain or url must be supplied. If both are sent, url takes precedence and domain is silently dropped.
782: ParameterTypeDescription
783: sourceStringCountry code of the regional keyword database (e.g., us, uk, de). See Regional database codes.
784: domainStringDomain to retrieve rankings for (e.g., booking.com). Mutually exclusive with url.
785: urlStringExact URL to retrieve rankings for (e.g., https://seranking.com/api.html). When supplied, the with_subdomains flag has no effect — only this exact URL is considered.
786: Search type, pagination, ordering
787: ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
788: typeorganic | advorganicSearch-traffic type. adv returns paid-search keywords with snippet fields populated.
789: with_subdomainsBooleantrueWhen true, include keywords ranking for any subdomain of domain. When false, restrict to the exact domain. Ignored when url is used. Also accepts 1/0.
790: pageInteger ≥ 11Page number for paginated results.
791: limitInteger 1–1000100Page size. Values > 1000 are silently capped at 1000.
792: order_fieldenumtrafficSort key. Valid values: traffic, volume, position, cpc, competition, kei, difficulty, traffic_percent, price.
793: order_typeasc | descdescSort direction.
794: colsString(default set)Comma-separated list of fields to return. See Default response columns. Invalid column names are silently dropped.
795: Historical snapshots (year / month)
796: ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
797: yearIntegercurrentYear of the historical snapshot to retrieve. Must be supplied together with month.
798: monthInteger 1–12currentMonth of the historical snapshot. Must be supplied together with year. Out-of-range values return HTTP 400 invalid month.
799: Semantics:
800: Both omitted → current snapshot.
801: Both supplied with a month within the retention window → historical snapshot.
802: Only one of the two supplied → current snapshot (the lone parameter is silently ignored — there is no error).
803: Future date → current snapshot (silent fallback).
804: Date older than the retention window → empty array [].
805: ⚠ Historical responses use a different schema than current responses. See Response shape — historical below. Clients that consume both must branch on whether year/month were sent.
806: Cost of history requests: a history request (past year + month) is billed per returned keyword: 5 credits per keyword, with no per-request charge. The cost grows with limit and with the number of pages you fetch. With limit=1000, a single call costs up to 5,000 credits, compared with 100 credits for the current snapshot. To pay the flat 100-credit price, omit year and month.
807: Filters
808: All filter keys use bracket-path syntax (filter[name]=value or filter[name][from]=value). Filters within a single key combine with AND; multiple values within one filter combine with OR.
809: Position-change filter
810: ParameterTypeDescription
811: pos_changeenumSelects keywords by how their position changed vs. the previous snapshot. Values: up (improved), down (worsened), new (prev_pos: null), lost (dropped from SERP), diff (any change — equivalent to up ∪ down), same (unchanged). Unknown values are silently ignored (filter does not apply).
812: Range filters (from / to)
813: All accept any combination of from and to; either bound can be omitted.
814: ParameterTypeNotes
815: filter[volume][from] / [to]Integer ≥ 0Monthly search volume.
816: filter[traffic][from] / [to]Integer ≥ 0Estimated monthly traffic to the ranking URL.
817: filter[traffic_percent][from] / [to]FloatShare (%) of the keyword’s total traffic captured by the domain.
818: filter[position][from] / [to]Integer ≥ 1Ranking position.
819: filter[keyword_count][from] / [to]Integer ≥ 1Number of words in the keyword phrase.
820: filter[characters_count][from] / [to]Integer ≥ 1Character length of the keyword phrase.
821: filter[cpc][from] / [to]Float ≥ 0Cost per click. USD.
822: filter[price][from] / [to]Float ≥ 0Estimated traffic value (PPC-equivalent). USD.
823: filter[competition][from] / [to]FloatCompetition score (0.00–1.00).
824: filter[difficulty][from] / [to]Integer 0–100Keyword difficulty.
825: Text filters
826: JSON-encoded value; see Text search JSON structure.
827: ParameterDescription
828: filter[keyword]Keyword text to match.
829: filter[multi_keyword_included]Must-include keyword tokens.
830: filter[multi_keyword_excluded]Must-exclude keyword tokens.
831: filter[url]Filter by ranking URL (substring/pattern). Single base array element only — no OR logic. Use the top-level url request param for an exact single-URL match.
832: Intent filter
833: ParameterDescription
834: filter[intents]Comma-separated short codes — I (informational), N (navigational), T (transactional), C (commercial), L (local). Multi-value semantics: keyword passes if any listed intent matches. Unknown codes are silently ignored.
835: SERP-feature filters — pick the right one
836: These two filters answer different questions:
837: FilterQuestion it answers
838: filter[serp_features]Does the SERP for this keyword have feature X at all? (Domain may or may not appear inside it.)
839: filter[serp_features_2]Is the analyzed domain actually mentioned inside feature X on the SERP?
840: Response parameters
841: Current
842: If the request succeeds, the server returns an HTTP 200 with a JSON array of keyword objects. The default response includes 16 fields; request cols= to project a subset.
843: Default response columns
844: When cols is omitted (or empty), all 16 of the following are returned:
845: Copy
846: block_position, block_type, competition, cpc, difficulty, intents, keyword,
847: position, prev_pos, price, serp_features, total_sites, traffic, traffic_percent,
848: url, volume
849: For type=adv (paid search), the block and snippet_* family are also returned when explicitly requested.
850: Field reference
851: FieldTypeDescription
852: keywordStringThe keyword phrase.
853: positionIntegerCurrent ranking position (organic) or ad position (paid).
854: prev_posInteger | nullPrevious-period position. null for new keywords.
855: volumeIntegerAverage monthly search volume.
856: cpcFloatAverage cost per click, USD.
857: competitionFloatCompetition score, 0.00 (low) – 1.00 (high).
858: difficultyIntegerKeyword difficulty, 0–100.
859: urlStringURL of the ranking page (or the URL used in the ad for paid).
860: total_sitesInteger | nullEstimated number of sites ranking for this keyword. Often null.
861: trafficIntegerEstimated monthly traffic this keyword drives to the URL.
862: traffic_percentFloatShare of the keyword’s total traffic the domain captures (%).
863: priceFloatEstimated traffic value (PPC equivalent), USD.
864: intentsArray\<String>Detected intents — short codes I / N / T / C / L.
865: serp_featuresArray\<String>SERP features present on this keyword’s SERP. See SERP features.
866: block_typeString | nullType of SERP block where the result appears (e.g., featured_snippets, tads, local_pack, sitelinks). null indicates an organic 10-blue-links result.
867: block_positionIntegerPosition of the block on the SERP.
868: blockString(Paid only.) Ad placement on the SERP, e.g., top, bottom.
869: snippet_numInteger(Paid only.) Identifier of the ad snippet.
870: snippets_countInteger(Paid only.) Number of ad snippets the domain runs on this keyword.
871: snippet_titleString(Paid only.) Ad title.
872: snippet_descriptionString(Paid only.) Ad body copy.
873: snippet_display_urlString(Paid only.) Display URL of the ad.
874: 📝 kei (Keyword Effectiveness Index) is accepted as an order_field value but is not a selectable response column. Requesting cols=kei silently drops it.

1135: Get paid ads by keyword
1136: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/ads
1137: Cost: 100 credits per request
1138: Retrieves an overview of paid advertisements (PPC ads) run by various domains for a specific target keyword. The method shows which domains are advertising on that keyword, the extent of their advertising efforts over a period, and details of their ad creatives.
1139: Request parameters
1140: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
1141: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code of the regional keyword database (e.g., us). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
1142: keywordStringYesN/ASpecific keyword for which to retrieve paid ad data. Accepts any valid keyword string (e.g., new york hotels).
1143: fromStringNoN/A (implies current/all available data)Starting year and month for the data retrieval period, formatted as YYYY-MM (e.g., 2017-01).
1144: toStringNoN/A (implies current/all available data)Ending year and month for the data retrieval period, formatted as YYYY-MM (e.g., 2023-12).
1145: pageIntegerNo1Page number for paginated results when retrieving domains advertising on the specified keyword (e.g., 1). Positive integer.
1146: limitIntegerNo100Maximum number of domains advertising on the specified keyword to return per page. Accepts values from 1 to 100 (e.g., 20).

1148: Copy
1149: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/ads?source=us&keyword=nyc+hotels&from=2023-01&to=2023-12&limit=10' \
1150: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'

1157: traffic_sumIntegerEstimation of the total traffic this domain received from its ads for all its keywords, not just the target one (e.g., 3565364).

1199: Copy
1200: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/ads?source=us&domain=booking.com&from=2023-01&to=2023-12&limit=10' \
1201: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1202: Response parameters
1203: If successful, the server returns a JSON array. Each object in the array represents a unique keyword that the specified domain has targeted with paid ads. It includes performance metrics for that keyword and details of the ad snippets run by the domain for that keyword.
1204: ParameterTypeDescription
1205: keywordStringKeyword phrase that the specified domain was advertising on (e.g., locanda vivaldi venice).
1206: ads_countIntegerNumber of unique ad creatives or instances observed from the specified domain for this keyword within the given period (e.g., 24).
1207: competitionFloatScore representing keyword competition. Float from 0.00 (low) to 1.00 (high).
1208: cpcFloatAverage CPC (Cost Per Click) for the keyword (e.g., 5.64).
1209: volumeIntegerAverage monthly search volume for this keyword (e.g., 100).
1210: snippets.positionIntegerObserved position of the ad snippet on the SERP (e.g., 2).
1211: snippets.snippet_titleStringTitle text of the specific advertisement (e.g., Locanda Vivaldi, Venice - Booking.com).
1212: snippets.snippet_descriptionStringDescriptive text body of the specific advertisement (e.g., Book at Locanda Vivaldi, Venice. No reservation costs...).
1213: snippets.snippet_display_urlStringURL displayed in the specific advertisement (e.g., www.booking.com/hotel/it/locanda-vivaldi.en.html?a).
1214: snippets.snippet_countIntegerCount or frequency of the specific snippet being observed (e.g., 1).
1215: snippets.snippet_numIntegerNumerical identifier for the specific ad snippet (e.g., 125).
1216: snippets.urlStringActual destination URL (landing page) of the specific advertisement (e.g., http://www.booking.com/hotel/it/locanda-vivaldi.en.html?aid=311088).
1217: Response example
1218: Copy
1219: [
1220: {
1221: "keyword": "locanda vivaldi venice",
1222: "ads_count": 24,
1223: "competition": "0.39",
1224: "cpc": "5.64",
1225: "volume": "100",
1226: "snippets": {
1227: "2017-01": {
1228: "position": "2",
1229: "snippet_title": "Locanda Vivaldi, Venice – Booking.com‎",
1230: "snippet_description": "Book at Locanda Vivaldi, Venice. No reservation costs. Great rates Amenities: Free Wifi, Non Smoking Rooms, 24 Hour Front Desk, Air Conditioning",
1231: "snippet_display_url": "www.booking.com/hotel/it/locanda-vivaldi.en.html?a",
1232: "snippet_count": "1",
1233: "snippet_num": 125,
1234: "url": "http://www.booking.com/hotel/it/locanda-vivaldi.en.html?aid=311088"
1235: }
1236: }
1237: }
1238: ]
1239: Get domain competitors
1240: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/competitors
1241: Cost: 100 credits per request
1242: Retrieves a list of competitor domains for a specified target domain. The list can be tailored to show organic or paid competitors, and can optionally include or exclude major industry players. Furthermore, the level of detail in the response can be adjusted to include basic information or more extensive statistics for each competitor. The maximum number of competitors returned is 500.
1243: Request parameters
1244: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
1245: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code of the regional keyword database (e.g., us). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
1246: domainStringYesN/APrimary domain for which to find competitors (e.g., seranking.com).
1247: typeStringNoorganicSearch traffic type for which data is retrieved:
1248: • organic – organic search traffic
1249: • adv – paid search traffic
1250: Request example
1251: Copy
1252: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/competitors?source=us&domain=yourtargetdomain.com&type=organic' \
1253: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1254: Response parameters
1255: If the request is successful, the server returns a JSON array. Each object in this array represents a competitor domain.
1256: ParameterTypeDescription
1257: domainStringDomain name of the competitor (e.g., tripadvisor.com).
1258: common_keywordsIntegerNumber of keywords for which both the analyzed domain and the competitor rank (e.g., 1076).
1259: domain_relevanceFloatA score indicating how closely the competitor’s keyword profile overlaps with the analyzed domain (e.g., 10.98). Higher values indicate greater relevance.
1260: total_keywordsIntegerNumber of keywords for which the competitor domain ranks within Google’s top 100 results in the specified database (e.g., 2084).
1261: missing_keywordsIntegerNumber of keywords for which the competitor ranks but the analyzed domain does not (e.g., 19511). Calculated as total_keywords - common_keywords.
1262: traffic_sumIntegerEstimated monthly traffic volume the competitor receives from its ranking keywords (e.g., 291). This is typically calculated based on expected CTR, search volume, and positions.
1263: price_sumFloatEstimated traffic value (PPC equivalent) of the competitor’s traffic.
1264: Response examples
1265: Copy
1266: [
1267: {
1268: "domain": "seoreviewtools.com",
1269: "common_keywords": 29926,
1270: "domain_relevance": 10.98,
1271: "total_keywords": 49437,
1272: "missing_keywords": 19511,
1273: "traffic_sum": 40619,
1274: "price_sum": 68705.61
1275: },
1276: {
1277: "domain": "keyword-tools.org",
1278: "common_keywords": 10110,
1279: "domain_relevance": 2.7,
1280: "total_keywords": 11183,
1281: "missing_keywords": 1073,
1282: "traffic_sum": 19544,
1283: "price_sum": 26071.28
1284: }
1285: ]
1286: Analyze keyword overlap and gaps
1287: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/keywords/comparison
1288: Cost: 100 credits per request
1289: Analyzes and compares the keyword rankings of two websites using either domains or full URLs. It can find keywords they have in common or identify a ‘keyword gap’— keywords for which one site ranks, but the other does not. This is useful for competitive analysis and identifying ranking opportunities.
1290: Request parameters
1291: Note: Either domain or url must be specified.
1292: When one option is provided, the other is ignored.
1293: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
1294: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code of the regional keyword database (e.g., us). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
1295: domainStringNoN/APrimary domain for the comparison (e.g., booking.com).
1296: urlStringNoN/APrimary full URL for the comparison (e.g., https://www.booking.com).
1297: compareStringYesN/ACompetitor domain or full URL to compare against the primary domain or URL. Must match the type of the primary parameter (domain or url).
1298: typeStringNoorganicSearch traffic type for which data is retrieved:
1299: • organic – organic search traffic
1300: • adv – paid search traffic
1301: pageIntegerNo1Page number for paginated results when retrieving keywords (e.g., 1). Positive integer.
1302: limitIntegerNo100Maximum number of keywords to return per page (e.g., 50). Accepts values from 1 to 1000.
1303: diffStringNo0Controls the comparison mode. Accepts values: 0, 1. See the section below for a detailed explanation.
1304: order_fieldStringNokeywordField by which results are sorted:
1305: • keyword
1306: • volume
1307: • cpc
1308: • competition
1309: • difficulty
1310: • position
1311: order_typeStringNoascSorting order:
1312: • asc – ascending
1313: • desc – descending
1314: colsStringNoAll relevant by defaultComma-separated list of response fields to include. If omitted, a default set of relevant columns is returned.
1315: filter[keyword]StringNoN/ACase-insensitive substring match on the keyword text (e.g., vegas).
1316: filter[multi_keyword_included]StringNoN/AJSON string specifying keyword text that must be included. See Text search JSON structure for formatting details.
1317: filter[multi_keyword_excluded]StringNoN/AJSON string specifying keyword text that must be excluded. See Text search JSON structure for formatting details.
1318: filter[volume][from]IntegerNoN/AMinimum monthly search volume for keywords to be included. Non-negative integer.
1319: filter[volume][to]IntegerNoN/AMaximum monthly search volume for keywords to be included. Non-negative integer.
1320: filter[cpc][from]FloatNoN/AMinimum CPC (Cost Per Click) value (e.g., 0.1). Non-negative float.
1321: filter[cpc][to]FloatNoN/AMaximum CPC (Cost Per Click) value (e.g., 2.5). Non-negative float.
1322: filter[competition][from]FloatNoN/AMinimum competition score. Float from 0.00 (low) to 1.00 (high).
1323: filter[competition][to]FloatNoN/AMaximum competition score. Float from 0.00 (low) to 1.00 (high).
1324: filter[difficulty][from]IntegerNoN/AMinimum keyword difficulty score (0–100).
1325: filter[difficulty][to]IntegerNoN/AMaximum keyword difficulty score (0–100).
1326: filter[intents]StringNoN/AComma-separated list of search intent codes. Returns keywords matching any of the specified intents (OR logic):
1327: • I – informational
1328: • N – navigational
1329: • T – transactional
1330: • C – commercial
1331: • L – local
1332: filter[serp_features]StringNoN/AComma-separated list of SERP feature codes. Returns keywords where any of the specified features is present on the SERP (OR logic), e.g., sitelinks,hotel_pack,people_also_ask. For acceptable values, see SERP features.
1333: Understanding the diff parameter
1334: The diff parameter controls the comparison mode by defining which set of keywords to return. For these examples, let A be the primary domain and B be the compare domain.
1335: diff=0: common keywords (A ∩ B)
1336: Returns keywords for which both the primary domain (A) and the compare domain (B) rank.
1337: diff=1: keyword gap (A – B)
1338: Returns keywords for which the primary domain (A) ranks, but the compare domain (B) does not.
1339: 💡 Pro tip: How to find your competitor’s unique keywords (B – A)
1340: To find the keywords for which the compare domain ranks but your primary domain does not, simply swap the domains in your request. Set the competitor’s domain as the primary domain and your domain as the compare domain, while keeping diff=1.
1341: For example, to see keywords hotels.com has that booking.com lacks, request: ...&domain=hotels.com&compare=booking.com&diff=1...
1342: Request examples
1343: Comparing domain names
1344: Copy
1345: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/keywords/comparison?source=us&domain=booking.com&compare=hotels.com&type=organic&diff=0&order_field=volume&order_type=desc' \
1346: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1347: Comparing URLs
1348: Copy
1349: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/keywords/comparison?source=us&url=https://www.booking.com&compare=https://www.hotels.com&type=organic&diff=1&order_type=desc&order_field=volume' \
1350: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1351: Comparing URLs
1352: Copy
1353: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/keywords/comparison?source=us&domain=booking.com&compare=hotels.com&type=organic&diff=0&filter[intents]=T&filter[volume][from]=1000&cols=keyword,volume,intents,position,compare_position' \
1354: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1355: Response parameters
1356: If the request is successful, the server returns a JSON array. Each object in this array represents a keyword and includes metrics for both the primary domain and the compare domain (where applicable, depending on the diff mode).
1357: ParameterTypeDescription
1358: keywordStringAnalyzed keyword phrase (e.g., haworth hotel holland mi).
1359: volumeIntegerAverage monthly number of Google searches for the specified keyword (e.g., 10).
1360: cpcFloatCPC (Cost Per Click) for the keyword (e.g., 3.01).
1361: competitionFloatScore representing keyword competition. Float from 0.00 (low) to 1.00 (high).
1362: difficultyIntegerKeyword difficulty for this keyword (from 0 to 100).
1363: total_sitesIntegerNumber of websites appearing in the search results for the query (e.g., 94).
1364: positionIntegerRanking position of the primary domain for the keyword (e.g., 4). Can be null if diff=1 and the primary domain doesn’t rank.
1365: urlStringURL of the primary domain’s page that ranks for this keyword (e.g., https://www.booking.com/hotel/us/haworth-inn-center.html). Can be null if diff=1.
1366: priceFloatEstimated cost/value of the traffic the primary domain receives from this keyword (e.g., 2.44). Can be null if diff=1.
1367: trafficFloatEstimated traffic the primary domain receives from this keyword (e.g., 0.81). Can be null if diff=1.
1368: compare_positionIntegerRanking position of the compare domain for this keyword (e.g., 5).
1369: compare_urlStringURL of the compare domain’s page that ranks for this keyword (e.g., https://www.hotels.com/ho576868/haworth/).
1370: compare_priceFloatEstimated cost/value of the traffic the compare domain receives from this keyword (e.g., 1.84).
1371: compare_trafficFloatEstimated traffic the compare domain receives from this keyword (e.g., 0.61).
1372: intentsArraySearch intent codes associated with the keyword. Possible values:
1373: • I – informational
1374: • N – navigational
1375: • T – transactional
1376: • C – commercial
1377: • L – local
1378: serp_featuresArraySERP features present for this keyword on the SERP (e.g., sitelinks, hotel_pack, people_also_ask). For acceptable values, see SERP features.
1379: Response examples
1380: The examples below show how the output differs depending on the diff parameter value.
1381: Common keywords (diff=0)
1382: This request finds keywords that booking.com and hotels.com have in common.
1383: Copy
1384: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/keywords/comparison?source=us&domain=booking.com&compare=hotels.com&type=organic&diff=0&limit=1' \
1385: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1386: Copy
1387: [
1388: {
1389: "keyword": "403",
1390: "volume": 33100,
1391: "cpc": 0.11,
1392: "competition": 0.05,
1393: "difficulty": 96,
1394: "total_sites": 0,
1395: "intents": [
1396: "I"
1397: ],
1398: "serp_features": [
1399: "video",
1400: "images",
1401: "knowledge_graph",
1402: "sge"
1403: ],
1404: "compare_position": 21,
1405: "compare_url": "https://seranking.com/blog/401-vs-403-error-codes/",
1406: "compare_price": 3.52,
1407: "compare_traffic": 32,
1408: "position": 25,
1409: "url": "https://www.wix.com/encyclopedia/definition/error-403",
1410: "price": 7.81,
1411: "traffic": 71
1412: }
1413: ]
1414: Keyword gap (diff=1)
1415: This request finds keywords for which the primary domain (booking.com) ranks, but the compare domain (hotels.com) does not.
1416: Copy
1417: curl -X GET 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/domain/keywords/comparison?source=us&domain=booking.com&compare=hotels.com&type=organic&diff=1&limit=1' \
1418: -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1419: Copy
1420: [
1421: {
1422: "keyword": "403",
1423: "volume": 33100,
1424: "cpc": 0.11,
1425: "competition": 0.05,
1426: "difficulty": 96,
1427: "total_sites": 0,
1428: "intents": [
1429: "I"
1430: ],
1431: "serp_features": [
1432: "video",
1433: "images",
1434: "knowledge_graph",
1435: "sge"
1436: ],
1437: "compare_position": 21,
1438: "compare_url": "https://seranking.com/blog/401-vs-403-error-codes/",
1439: "compare_price": 3.52,
1440: "compare_traffic": 32,
1441: "position": 25,
1442: "url": "https://www.wix.com/encyclopedia/definition/error-403",
1443: "price": 7.81,
1444: "traffic": 71
1445: }
1446: ]
1447: Text search JSON structure
1448: The text search structure allows for the creation of complex text searches by providing a JSON string in the format array<array<object>>.
1449: The first (outer) layer of the array corresponds to elements separated by logical OR.
1450: The second (inner) layer of the array corresponds to elements with logical AND.
1451: Each object within the inner array has the following structure:
1452: Copy
1453: {"type": "begins","value": "google"}
1454: Object properties
1455: NameDescription
1456: object.valueContains the text value to be searched.
1457: object.typeSpecifies the type of search to be performed.
1458: List of possible object.type variants
1459: NameDescription
1460: beginsSearched text should start with the specified value.
1461: containsSearched text should contain the specified value anywhere within the text.
1462: endsSearched text should end with the specified value.
1463: exactSearched text should exactly match the specified value.
1464: Example of a complex JSON filter structure
1465: To find keywords that contain “seo tools” AND (begin with “free” OR begin with “best”), the JSON for filter[multi_keyword_included] would be:
1466: Copy
1467: [
1468: [
1469: {"type": "contains","value": "seo tools"},
1470: {"type": "begins","value": "free"}
1471: ],
1472: [
1473: {"type": "contains","value": "seo tools"},
1474: {"type": "begins","value": "best"}
1475: ]
1476: ]
1477: This example illustrates the OR (outer array) and AND (inner array) logic. The filter[url] parameter is simpler as it doesn’t use the OR logic and only accepts a single inner array, e.g., [[{"type":"contains","value":"/blog"}]].

436: Website Audit
437: Website Audit API provides programmatic access to technical SEO audits. Results are retrieved on demand.
438: Using the API, you can:
439: Create website audits using standard HTML crawling or JavaScript-rendered crawling
440: Track audit execution by checking audit status, progress, and crawl statistics in real time
441: Retrieve audit results, including health scores and categorized issues
442: Analyze pages and audit issues, including page-level technical metrics and URLs affected by specific issues
443: Analyze link data, including internal and external links discovered during the crawl
444: Manage audits by listing, filtering, renaming, deleting, and accessing historical audit snapshots
445: Create audit
446: There are two endpoints for launching a new website audit. Use the Standard endpoint for most websites, and the Advanced endpoint for sites that rely heavily on JavaScript to render content, such as Single-Page Applications (SPAs).
447: Create standard audit
448: POST https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/standard
449: Cost: 2 credits per crawled page
450: Launches a standard audit that crawls the HTML of a website. This is suitable for most static and server-side rendered sites.
451: Create advanced audit
452: POST https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/advanced
453: Cost: 20 credits per crawled page
454: Launches an advanced audit that renders JavaScript before analyzing the page. Use this for single-page applications (SPAs) or any site where content is loaded dynamically.
455: Request parameters
456: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
457: domainStringYesN/ADomain to be audited (e.g., domain.com).
458: titleStringNodomainCustom title for the audit report. Maximum 300 characters.
459: settingsObjectNoN/AObject containing specific audit settings. Only include parameters you want to override. See the Audit settings table below.
460: Settings

657: Get audit status
658: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/status
659: Cost: 0 credits
660: Checks the real-time status of a specific website audit, whether it’s queued, currently processing, or already finished. This is useful for monitoring the progress of a crawl before fetching the full report.
661: Request parameters
662: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
663: audit_idIntegerYesN/AUnique identifier of the audit to check.

669: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing the current status and key metrics of the audit.
670: ParameterTypeDescription
671: statusStringCurrent status of the audit. Possible values: queued, processing, finished, cancelled, expired.
672: total_pagesIntegerNumber of pages crawled so far.
673: total_errorsIntegerCurrent count of critical issues found.
674: total_warningsIntegerCurrent count of warnings found.
675: total_passedIntegerCurrent count of checks that have passed.
676: start_timeStringTimestamp for when the audit began.
677: audit_timeStringTimestamp for when the audit was completed. This will be present if the status is finished.

689: Get audit report
690: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/report
691: Cost: 0 credits
692: Retrieves the full, detailed report for a completed website audit. The report includes the site’s overall health score, domain properties, and a section-by-section breakdown of all checks performed, categorized by issue type (errors, warnings, notices).
693: Request parameters
694: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
695: audit_idIntegerYesN/AUnique identifier of the audit for which to retrieve the report.
696: Request example
697: Copy
698: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/report?audit_id=700183831' \
699: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
700: Response parameters
701: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing the complete audit report.
702: ParameterTypeDescription
703: is_finishedBooleanIndicates if the audit has completed. The report is only available if this is true.
704: score_percentIntegerOverall health score of the website, from 0 to 100.
705: total_pagesIntegerTotal number of pages crawled during the audit.
706: total_errorsIntegerTotal count of critical issues found.
707: total_warningsIntegerTotal count of warnings found.
708: total_noticesIntegerTotal count of minor issues or notices.
709: total_passedIntegerTotal count of checks that passed successfully.
710: audit_timeStringTimestamp for when the audit was completed.
711: domain_propsObjectObject containing general data about the audited domain. See details below.
712: sectionsArrayArray of objects, where each object represents a category of audit checks (e.g., Security, Content).
713: domain_props object
714: ParameterTypeDescription
715: expdateStringExpiration date of the domain registration.
716: backlinksStringTotal number of backlinks pointing to the domain.
717: index_googleStringNumber of pages indexed in Google.
718: sections array
719: Each object in the sections array contains a uid (unique ID), a name for the category, and a props object. The props object lists all the individual checks for that category. Each check includes:
720: code: A unique identifier for the check (e.g., no_https).
721: status: The result of the check (error, warning, notice, passed).
722: name: A human-readable name for the check.
723: value: The number of pages affected by this issue.

1136: Get all found links
1137: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/links
1138: Cost: 0 credits
1139: Returns a paginated list of every hyperlink (e.g., in <a> tags, canonicals) discovered across the entire site during the audit. It allows for a complete analysis of all internal and outbound links.
1140: Request parameters
1141: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
1142: audit_idIntegerYesN/AUnique identifier of the audit.
1143: page_typeStringNoallFilters links by type. Possible values: internal, external, all.
1144: filterArrayNoN/AArray of filter objects to build complex queries. Allows for filtering on link properties like HTTP status. See details below.
1145: limitIntegerNoN/ANumber of links to return in the list.
1146: offsetIntegerNoN/AStarting position for the list of links.
1147: Advanced filtering
1148: To build complex queries, you can add an array of filter parameters to the URL query string. This allows you to chain multiple conditions together using logical operators.
1149: Each filter consists of three parts, formatted with an index in brackets (e.g., filter[0], filter[1]):
1150: filter[index][param]: (Required) The field you want to filter on.
1151: filter[index][value]: (Required) The value to match.
1152: filter[index][type]: The logical operator (and or or) to connect this condition to the previous one. This is required for the second condition onwards (i.e., for filter[1], filter[2], etc.).
1153: Available filterable parameters (param):
1154: status
1155: type
1156: source_noindex
1157: nofollow
1158: anchor_type
1159: Example 1: OR logic
1160: To find all internal links that have a status code of either 301 OR 302.
1161: Copy
1162: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/links?audit_id=700183831&page_type=internal&limit=10&filter[0][param]=status&filter[0][value]=301&filter[1][param]=status&filter[1][value]=302&filter[1][type]=or' \
1163: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1164: filter[0] sets the base condition (status = 301).
1165: filter[1][type]=or explicitly connects the next condition (status = 302) with an OR.
1166: Example 2: AND logic
1167: To find all broken (404) image links (anchor_type = image).
1168: Copy
1169: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/links?audit_id=700183831&page_type=internal&limit=10&filter[0][param]=status&filter[0][value]=404&filter[1][param]=anchor_type&filter[1][value]=image&filter[1][type]=and' \
1170: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1171: filter[0] sets the base condition (status = 404).
1172: filter[1][type]=and must be included to connect the second condition (anchor_type = image) with an AND. Omitting it would result in an error.
1173: Request example
1174: Copy
1175: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/site-audit/audits/links?audit_id=700183831&page_type=all&limit=4&offset=0' \
1176: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
1177: Response parameters
1178: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing the total count of links and an array of link objects.
1179: ParameterTypeDescription
1180: totalIntegerTotal number of links matching the filter criteria.
1181: itemsArrayArray of objects, each representing a discovered link.
1182: Each object in the items array has the following structure:
1183: ParameterTypeDescription
1184: urlStringDestination URL of the link (e.g., https://www.vitality.co.uk/).
1185: idStringUnique identifier for this specific link instance (e.g., 1153787496).
1186: statusStringHTTP status code of the destination URL (e.g., 200).
1187: typeStringType of the link (e.g., hyperlink, canonical).
1188: source_urlStringURL of the page where the link was discovered (e.g., https://www.vitality.co.uk/advisers/).
1189: source_noindexStringIndicates if the source page has a noindex directive (“1” for yes, “0” for no).
1190: nofollowStringIndicates if the link has a rel=”nofollow” attribute (“1” for yes, “0” for no).
1191: anchorStringVisible, clickable text of the link (e.g., Personal).
1192: anchor typeStringType of the anchor element (e.g., text, image).
1193: Response example
1194: A successful request returns a JSON object containing a list of all discovered links.

434: API
435: Data API / AI Search
436: AI Search
437: AI Search API provides programmatic access to a domain’s performance in Large Language Model (LLM) results. Data is refreshed on a monthly basis.
438: Using the API, you can:
439: get an AI search overview with metrics like link presence, average position, AI traffic, and historical trends
440: compare a primary domain against competitors across multiple LLM engines and retrieve a share of voice leaderboard
441: discover the brand associated with a domain or URL
442: retrieve prompts by target, showing where a domain or URL appears in LLM responses
443: retrieve prompts by brand, showing where a brand is mentioned in LLM results
444: Get AI search overview
445: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/overview/by-engine/time-series
446: Cost: 800 credits per request
447: Retrieves a high-level overview of a domain’s brand presence in an LLM, including historical trends over time and other metrics like link presence, average position, and AI traffic.
448: Request parameters
449: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
450: engineStringYesN/ALLM to query (e.g., ai-overview, chatgpt, gemini, ai-mode).
451: targetStringYesN/ATarget to analyze for LLM performance. Can be a root domain, subdomain, or a specific URL (e.g., seranking.com).
452: sourcestringYesN/ACountry code for the regional prompt database (e.g., us for the United States results). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
453: scopeStringNobase_domainScope of analysis:
454: • base_domain – aggregate by registrable domain, includes all subdomains.
455: • domain – exact host only, no subdomain aggregation.
456: • url – exact URL including path and query.
457: brandStringNoN/ABrand to filter the brand presence analysis (e.g., SE Ranking).
458: Request example
459: Copy
460: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/overview/by-engine/time-series?target=seranking.com&source=us&engine=ai-overview' \
461: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
462: Response parameters
463: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing aggregated metrics, changes from the previous period, and time-series data for generating charts.
464: ParameterTypeDescription
465: summaryObjectObject containing key performance metrics like brand_presence, link_presence, average_position, and ai_opportunity_traffic.
466: time_seriesObjectObject containing historical data arrays for overall_traffic, organic_traffic, ai_traffic, link_presence, and average_position.
467: Each object within the summary object has the following structure:
468: ParameterTypeDescription
469: currentFloatValue for the current period.
470: previousFloatValue for the previous period.
471: change_absoluteFloatAbsolute difference between the current and previous periods.
472: change_percentFloatPercentage change between the current and previous periods.
473: Each array within the time_series object contains a series of objects with the following structure:
474: ParameterTypeDescription
475: dateStringMonth and year of the data point in YYYY-MM format.
476: valueFloatMetric’s value for that month.
477: Response example

529: Get AI search leaderboard
530: POST https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/overview/leaderboard
531: Cost: 7,500 credits per request (flat)
532: Compares a primary domain against up to 10 competitors across multiple LLM engines and returns a share of voice leaderboard showing which domains have the highest AI search visibility. The leaderboard is calculated based on both brand and link presence across the selected engines.
533: Request parameters
534: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
535: primaryObjectYesN/APrimary domain and brand information.
536: competitorsArrayYesN/AList of competitors to compare (1–10 items).
537: scopeStringNobase_domainScope of the analysis:
538: • base_domain – aggregate by registrable domain, includes all subdomains.
539: • domain – exact host only, no subdomain aggregation.
540: • url – exact URL including path and query.
541: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code for the regional database (e.g., us for United States results). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
542: enginesArrayYesN/ALLM engines to query (ai-overview, chatgpt, gemini, ai-mode).
543: Each object within the primary parameter has the following structure:
544: ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
545: targetStringYesTarget to analyze for LLM performance. Can be a root domain, subdomain, or a specific URL (e.g., seranking.com).
546: brandStringNoBrand name (e.g., SE Ranking).
547: Each object within the competitors parameter has the following structure:
548: ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
549: targetStringYesCompetitor to analyze for LLM performance. Can be a root domain, subdomain, or a specific URL (e.g., semrush.com).
550: brandStringNoCompetitor brand name (e.g., Semrush).
551: Request example
552: Copy
553: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/overview/leaderboard' \
554: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY' \
555: --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
556: --data '{
557: "primary": {
558: "target": "example.com",
559: "brand": "Example"
560: },
561: "competitors": [
562: { "target": "example1.com", "brand": "Example 1" },
563: { "target": "example2.com", "brand": "Example 2" }
564: ],
565: "scope": "base_domain",
566: "source": "us",
567: "engines": ["ai-overview", "chatgpt"]
568: }'
569: Response parameters
570: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing leaderboard and per-domain, per-engine metrics.
571: ParameterTypeDescription
572: request_metadataObjectMetadata describing the request.
573: leaderboardArrayLeaderboard of domains sorted by share of voice.
574: resultsObjectDetailed per-domain, per-engine metrics.
575: Each object in request_metadata has the following structure:
576: ParameterTypeDescription
577: primaryStringPrimary target domain.
578: competitorsArrayCompetitor domains included in the request.
579: enginesArrayEngines used for the comparison.
580: sourceStringCountry code for the regional database.
581: Each object in leaderboard array has the following structure:
582: ParameterTypeDescription
583: rankIntegerPosition in the leaderboard (1 = highest share of voice).
584: domainStringDomain name.
585: share_of_voiceFloatCalculated share of voice.
586: brand_presenceIntegerTotal brand mentions across selected engines.
587: link_presenceIntegerTotal link citations across selected engines.
588: is_primary_targetBooleanIndicates whether this is the primary domain.
589: Each object in results has the following structure:
590: Each domain object (results.{domain}) contains:
591: ParameterTypeDescription
592: {engine}ObjectMetrics for a specific engine.
593: Each engine object (results.{domain}.{engine}) contains:
594: ParameterTypeDescription
595: brand_presenceIntegerBrand presence for this domain on this engine.
596: link_presenceIntegerLink presence for this domain on this engine.

671: Discover brand by URL
672: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/discover-brand
673: Cost: 100 credits per request
674: Identifies the brand name associated with the specified target domain. This utility endpoint is useful for programmatically finding a brand before using it in other queries.
675: Request parameters
676: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
677: targetStringYesN/ATarget to analyze for LLM performance. Can be a root domain, subdomain, or a specific URL (e.g., seranking.com).
678: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code for the regional prompt database (e.g., us for United States results). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
679: scopeStringYesbase_domainScope of analysis:
680: • base_domain – aggregate by registrable domain, includes all subdomains.
681: • domain – exact host only, no subdomain aggregation.
682: • url – exact URL including path and query.
683: Request example
684: Copy
685: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/discover-brand?target=microsoft.com&scope=domain&source=us' \
686: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
687: Response parameters
688: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing an array of discovered brand names.
689: ParameterTypeDescription
690: brandsArrayArray of strings, each a potential brand name.

695: "Microsoft"

697: }
698: Get prompts by target
699: GET https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/prompts-by-target
700: Cost: 200 credits per returned prompt
701: Retrieves a paginated list of prompts where the specified domain, subdomain, or URL appears in LLM results.
702: Request parameters
703: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
704: engineStringYesN/ALLM to query (e.g., ai-overview, chatgpt, gemini, ai-mode).
705: targetStringYesN/ATarget to analyze for LLM performance. Can be a root domain, subdomain, or a specific URL.
706: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code for the regional prompt database (e.g., us for United States results).
707: For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
708: scopeStringYesbase_domainScope of the analysis:
709: • base_domain – aggregate by registrable domain, includes all subdomains.
710: • domain – exact host only, no subdomain aggregation.
711: • url – exact URL including path and query.
712: sortStringNovolumeField to sort the results by: volume, type, snippet_length.
713: sort_orderStringNodescSort order for the results:
714: • asc – for ascending
715: • desc – for descending
716: limitIntegerNo100Maximum number of prompts to return per page (max 1000).
717: offsetIntegerNo0Starting position for the paginated list.
718: filterObjectNoN/AObject for filtering results. See the Filtering results section for details.
719: Request example
720: Copy
721: curl --location --globoff 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/prompts-by-target?target=seranking.com&scope=domain&source=us&engine=ai-mode&limit=1' \
722: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
723: Response parameters
724: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing a list of prompts and metadata.
725: ParameterTypeDescription
726: totalIntegerTotal number of prompts found for the target.
727: dateStringDate of the data snapshot in YYYY-MM-DD format.
728: promptsArrayArray of objects, each representing a found prompt.
729: Each object in the prompts array has the following structure:
730: ParameterTypeDescription
731: promptStringUser query or prompt text that triggered the LLM response.
732: volumeIntegerEstimated monthly search volume for the prompt.
733: typeStringType of appearance for the target in the LLM result (e.g., Link, Brand).
734: answerObjectObject containing the detailed response from the LLM.
735: The answer object contains the following fields:
736: ParameterTypeDescription
737: textStringFull text of the snippet generated by the LLM.
738: linksArrayArray of URL strings that were included as links within the LLM’s answer.
739: Response example
740: Copy
741: {
742: "total": 5448,
743: "date": "2025-09-01",
744: "prompts": [

747: "volume": 14800,

750: "text": "Hay una gran variedad de peliculas disponibles en Netflix...",
751: "links": [ "[https://movies.sitioficial.netflix.com/browse/genre/34399](https://movies.sitioficial.netflix.com/browse/genre/34399)" ]
752: }
753: }
754: ]
755: }

761: ParameterTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
762: engineStringYesN/ALLM to query (e.g., ai-overview, chatgpt, gemini, ai-mode).
763: brandStringYesN/ABrand name to search for in LLM snippets.
764: sourceStringYesN/ACountry code for the regional prompt database (e.g., us for United States results). For acceptable values, see Regional database codes.
765: sortStringNovolumeField to sort the results by: volume, type, snippet_length.
766: sort_orderStringNodescSort order for the results:
767: • asc – for ascending
768: • desc – for descending
769: limitIntegerNo100Maximum number of prompts to return per page (max 1000).
770: offsetIntegerNo0Starting position for the paginated list.
771: filterObjectNoN/AObject for filtering results. See the Filtering results section for details.
772: Request example
773: Copy
774: curl --location 'https://api.seranking.com/v1/ai-search/prompts-by-brand?brand=Netflix&source=us&engine=chatgpt&sort=volume&sort_order=desc&offset=0&limit=10' \
775: --header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
776: Response parameters
777: If successful, the server returns a JSON object containing a list of prompts that mention the specified brand.
778: ParameterTypeDescription
779: totalIntegerTotal number of times the brand has been mentioned in the specified LLM for the current month.
780: dateStringDate of the data snapshot in YYYY-MM-DD format.
781: promptsArrayArray of objects, each representing a found prompt. See the structure below for details.
782: Each object in the prompts array has the following structure:
783: ParameterTypeDescription
784: promptStringUser query or prompt text that triggered the LLM response.
785: volumeIntegerEstimated monthly search volume for the prompt.
786: typeStringType of appearance for the target in the LLM result (e.g., Link, Brand).
787: answerObjectObject containing the detailed response from the LLM.
788: The answer object contains the following fields:
789: ParameterTypeDescription
790: textStringFull text of the snippet generated by the LLM.
791: linksArrayArray of URL strings that were included as links within the LLM’s answer.
792: Response example
793: Copy
794: {
795: "total": 5448,
796: "date": "2025-09-01",
797: "prompts": [
798: {
799: "prompt": "peliculas en netflix",
800: "volume": 14800,
801: "type": "Link",
802: "answer": {
803: "text": "Hay una gran variedad de peliculas disponibles en Netflix...",
804: "links": [ "[https://movies.sitioficial.netflix.com/browse/genre/34399](https://movies.sitioficial.netflix.com/browse/genre/34399)" ]
805: }
806: }
807: ]
808: }
809: Filtering results
810: The Get prompts by target and Get prompts by brand endpoints support advanced filtering to refine your search results. The filter parameter is passed as an object in the query string.
811: Range filters (volume, keyword_count, characters_count)
812: These filters allow you to specify a numeric range for your results. Both from and to values are inclusive. You can use one or both to define the range.
813: To get values greater than or equal to a number: Use filter[<parameter>][from]=<value>.
814: Example: filter[volume][from]=100 returns prompts with a search volume of 100 or more.
815: To get values less than or equal to a number: Use filter[<parameter>][to]=<value>.
816: Example: filter[keyword_count][to]=5 returns prompts with 5 or fewer words.
817: To get values within a specific range: Use both from and to.
818: Example: filter[characters_count][from]=10&filter[characters_count][to]=50 returns prompts that are between 10 and 50 characters long.
819: Text search filters (multi_keyword_included, multi_keyword_excluded)
820: These filters allow you to include or exclude specific keywords from the prompt text.
821: multi_keyword_included: A URL-encoded JSON string specifying keywords that must be present in the prompt.
822: multi_keyword_excluded: A URL-encoded JSON string specifying keywords that must not be present in the prompt.
823: For details on how to structure the JSON for these filters, please refer to the Text search JSON structure documentation.
